name: SimPay mock gateway callback contract v1
signature: HMAC-SHA256 over canonical JSON (sorted keys, no spaces), hex, header X-SimPay-Signature
rules: PENDING is a non-final state; a later callback will carry SUCCESS or FAILED.
Callbacks may be delivered more than once with the same event_id; process each event_id once.
Reject callbacks whose signature does not verify.
Never move an order out of a final state.

Any status not listed in status_to_order_state is unknown: do NOT change the order and do NOT mark the event processed; respond with a non-2xx error so the gateway retries after the merchant is updated.
